scope: Private exploratory aggregate development check after four-case orientation/correction feasibility; not confirmation, student preregistration, held-out evaluation, or acceleration evidence
selection: All eight pinned original validation inverse slices, all 24 original source/frequency blocks per slice, four parent groups; no exclusions or rank search
direction: For each method/slice, negative SUM of all 24 physical approximate block gradients, normalized by one common L2 norm; zero if norm<=1e-14
acceptance: SUM approximate Dphi + SUM all24 block error bounds <0, only if every block stability is available; otherwise retain fallback-required case
coverage: Absolute aggregate error <= SUM24 bounds +1e-12; retain all individual block errors and bound checks with the same shared aggregate direction
uncertainty: Equal-parent descriptive summaries across four parents; no IID-eight-slice or inferential coverage claim
gram_allowance: Same private feasibility formula: max(0,-lambda_min(G))+128*eps*rank*max(||H||2+||Vr||2^2,1) added to G diagonal; explicitly not a formally verified rounding enclosure

output_contract.families_or_parent_pooling: Retain parent identity; report every method and slice separately plus equal-parent descriptions
